description: This file defines a generic Registry class with methods for managing key-value pairs, including support for asynchronous loaders, event listeners, and configurable overwrite policies. It also includes related types, interfaces, and enums for registry configuration and behavior.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: A generic class for managing a collection of items with support for synchronous and asynchronous loaders, event listeners, and configurable overwrite policies.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Registry instance with optional configuration.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items and promises from the registry and notifies listeners.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the registry.

methods.name: registerValue
methods.description: Registers a value with a specific key, respecting the overwrite policy.

methods.name: registerLoader
methods.description: Registers a loader function for a specific key, respecting the overwrite policy.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value or loader result associated with a key.

methods.name: getAsPromise
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to the value associated with a key.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns a map of all keys to their current values.

methods.name: getMapAsPromise
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to a map of all keys to their values.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an array of all keys in the registry.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an array of all current values in the registry.

methods.name: valuesAsPromise
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to an array of all values.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Returns an array of key-value pair objects.

methods.name: entriesAsPromise
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to an array of key-value pair objects.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated item from the registry.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener function to be called on registry changes.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a previously added listener function.

methods.name: notifyListeners
methods.description: Internal method to notify all registered listeners of changes.
